title: AI
subtitle: Optional. The app works fully without AI; it is a shortcut for typing and photos.
intro: Any endpoint compatible with the OpenAI chat-completions format works, including local models. The key is encrypted and never shown again in full.
endpointHelp: Base URL ending in /v1, for example a hosted provider or a local server.
visionModelHelp: Leave empty to use the text model.
apiKeyHelp: Leave empty to keep the stored key.
fallbackHelp: Used automatically when the main one fails.
sent: What is sent to the provider
sentBody: Only what you type or attach in the input bar, plus the names of your accounts and categories so the model can refer to them. Never balances, transactions, passwords or keys.
